command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo '== astropy: units, WCS, coordinates, time, FITS -- each an exact/definitional identity =='
cat > recipe.py <<'PYEOF'
import numpy as np, sys
from astropy import units as u
from astropy.constants import c
from astropy.wcs import WCS
from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord
from astropy.time import Time
from astropy.io import fits
import astropy

lines=[f"astropy {astropy.__version__}  (all identities exact/algorithmic/definitional)"]
fail=[]
def chk(label, ok, detail):
    line=f"{label:16s} {detail}  [{'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'}]"; print(line); lines.append(line)
    if not ok: fail.append(label)

cval=c.to('m/s').value
chk("speed_of_light", cval==299792458.0, f"c={cval} m/s want exactly 299792458 (SI definition)")

w=WCS(naxis=2); w.wcs.crpix=[256.5,256.5]; w.wcs.cdelt=[-0.000277778,0.000277778]
w.wcs.crval=[150.0,2.0]; w.wcs.ctype=['RA---TAN','DEC--TAN']
px=np.array([[10.,20.],[100.,300.],[500.5,7.25],[256.5,256.5]])
err=float(np.abs(px-w.wcs_world2pix(w.wcs_pix2world(px,0),0)).max())
chk("wcs_roundtrip", err<1e-9, f"max|pix-rt|={err:.2e} px want <1e-9 (TAN pix->world->pix)")

ngp=SkyCoord(l=0*u.deg,b=90*u.deg,frame='galactic').icrs
chk("ngp_ra",  abs(ngp.ra.deg-192.85948)<1e-4, f"NGP RA={ngp.ra.deg:.6f} deg want 192.85948 (IAU)")
chk("ngp_dec", abs(ngp.dec.deg-27.12825)<1e-4, f"NGP Dec={ngp.dec.deg:.6f} deg want 27.12825 (IAU)")

dt=(Time('2026-01-01T00:00:00',scale='tai')-Time('2026-01-01T00:00:00',scale='tt')).sec
chk("tt_minus_tai", abs(dt-32.184)<1e-6, f"TT-TAI={dt:.6f} s want 32.184 (definitional)")

data=(np.arange(256*256,dtype=np.float32).reshape(256,256)*1.5-100.0)
fits.PrimaryHDU(data=data,header=w.to_header()).writeto('astro.fits',overwrite=True)
chk("fits_roundtrip", np.array_equal(fits.getdata('astro.fits'),data), f"FITS data bit-identical, shape {data.shape}")

lines.append("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED "+str(fail))
open('smoke-check.txt','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
print("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED")
sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)

PYEOF
python3 recipe.py
